derivation.method: Manual integer set accounting and rational arithmetic from the frozen two-episode public fixture bytes; probability losses retained as analytic natural-log expressions.
derivation.hard_policy: as_recorded, so every recorded raw outcome is the final outcome.
derivation.probability_working_values: Every binary label decision gives probability 4/5 to its observed outcome, yielding per-label and mean Brier 1/25 and analytic loss -ln(4/5).
derivation.independence: No Validator command, production scoring source, Validator output, private T029/T030 artifact, production-derived expected fixture, or internal numerical handoff was used.

hash_exclusion: manifest.json deliberately has no self-hash to avoid a circular digest dependency.
